process_area.title: Import ICC/SOC Clearance, Testing Lab & Sticker Management

value_stream.name: DTI-BPS Product Standards Certification & PS Mark/ICC Compliance

fields.Frequency: Per import shipment of regulated goods
fields.Participants: Import Coordinator, Product Compliance Manager, Customs Broker (links to VS-87), Buyer (links to VS-01), Vendor (links to VS-03), DC (links to VS-04)
fields.Trigger: Import PO for regulated product (links to VS-02.2/W2B); shipment departure
fields.Volume: ~10–15 regulated import shipments/month (~400–600 TEUs/month total imports)

workflows.name: Import ICC/SOC Application & PCIMS Portal Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-file of "file the ICC or SOC application via DTI's PCIMS portal upon shipment departure…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "Import Coordinator manages the PCIMS application lifecycle" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-import of "Import Coordinator/Product Compliance Manager maintain the ICC/SOC application…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-581 (ensure controlled execution — Import ICC/SOC Clearance, Testing Lab & Sticker Management (PA-117.2).)
- operational: checklist and pre-submission review; operational: early filing and lab planning (W3680)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Application-error risk**: Incorrect ICC-vs-SOC selection or missing documents causes rejection and delay; mitigated by checklist and pre-submission review
- **Cycle-time risk**: Slow BPS review extends port dwell and demurrage cost; mitigated by early filing and lab planning (W3680)
System Touchpoints: - Import tracker / PCIMS portal integration; import PO (links to VS-02.2/W2B); customs (links to VS-87); DC receiving (links to VS-04); demurrage (links to W249); ICC register (links to W3672)

steps.activity: Import Coordinator/Product Compliance Manager file the ICC or SOC application via DTI's PCIMS portal upon shipment departure from origin: select ICC (foreign maker without PS License) vs. SOC (foreign maker holds valid PS License), attach the Bill of Lading, Packing List, Commercial Invoice, and Certificate of Origin, and pay the BPS fee

Import Coordinator manages the PCIMS application lifecycle: track status, respond to BPS queries, manage the documentary-review loop (W3674), and coordinate timing against vessel arrival, customs release (links to VS-87), and DC delivery (links to VS-04) to minimize port dwell/demurrage (links to W249)

Import Coordinator/Product Compliance Manager maintain the ICC/SOC application register, forecast upcoming regulated-import demand for BPS resource/lab planning (links to W3680), and report ICC cycle-time and clearance rate to program analytics (links to W3685)

fields.Participants: Import Coordinator, Customs Broker, Product Compliance Manager, Vendor, Legal (links to VS-100.3), Records (links to VS-88)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "documentary package for BPS review" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "Import Coordinator manages the BPS documentary-review loop" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "Records archive the complete documentary package to the technical file" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-581 (ensure controlled execution — Import ICC/SOC Clearance, Testing Lab & Sticker Management (PA-117.2).)
- operational: pre-shipment vendor coordination; operational: Product Compliance review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Document-deficiency risk**: Incomplete/incorrect origin documents delay BPS review; mitigated by pre-shipment vendor coordination
- **Mis-classification risk**: Product mis-classified against the wrong PNS, triggering wrong test; mitigated by Product Compliance review
System Touchpoints: - Import documents (links to VS-02.2); customs entry (links to VS-87); records/retention (links to VS-88); technical file (links to W3668); ICC register (links to W3672)

steps.activity: Import Coordinator/Customs Broker assemble and submit the documentary package for BPS review: validated Bill of Lading, Packing List, Commercial Invoice, Certificate of Origin, the foreign maker's PS License (for SOC), test reports where required, and the product/standard identification

Import Coordinator manages the BPS documentary-review loop: respond to queries, correct deficiencies, and confirm product-to-standard classification with BPS; coordinate with the vendor for missing/incorrect origin documents

Import Coordinator/Records archive the complete documentary package to the technical file (links to W3668) and ICC register (links to W3672) per retention (links to VS-88), supporting customs entry (links to VS-87) and future audit

fields.Participants: Import Coordinator, Product Compliance Manager, DTI Inspector, Customs Broker (links to VS-87), DC/QC (links to VS-04/VS-31), Vendor
fields.Trigger: Shipment arrival at port/DC; BPS inspection notice

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-inspect of "inspection and sampling upon arrival" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "document the sample draw" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-post of "Import Coordinator manages post-inspection" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-581 (ensure controlled execution — Import ICC/SOC Clearance, Testing Lab & Sticker Management (PA-117.2).)
- operational: witnessed sampling and PNS procedure; operational: expediting testing (W3676)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Sampling-dispute risk**: Disagreement on sample representativeness; mitigated by witnessed sampling and PNS procedure
- **Hold-cost risk**: Sampled lots held pending test results incur storage/dwell cost; mitigated by expediting testing (W3676)
System Touchpoints: - Import/DC receiving (links to VS-04/VS-02.2); quality sampling (links to VS-31.1); lot/batch tracking (links to VS-29); lab management (links to W3676); customs (links to VS-87)

steps.activity: Import Coordinator/Product Compliance Manager coordinate the DTI physical inspection and sampling upon arrival: schedule the BPS inspector at port or DC, confirm the lot/sample location, and arrange BuildRight witness (QC/Product Compliance) per BPS procedure
steps.r: Import Coordinator / Product Compliance Manager / DC-QC

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager/QC witness the BPS inspection and sampling: confirm representative random sampling per the PNS sampling plan, document the sample draw (quantities, lot/batch, photos), and manage chain-of-custody to the accredited lab (links to W3676)

Import Coordinator manages post-inspection: release of the unsampled balance (where BPS permits), hold of sampled lots pending test results (links to W3676), and coordination with customs release (links to W3677) and DC putaway (links to VS-04)

fields.Frequency: Per shipment (and per PS License factory audit)
fields.Participants: Product Compliance Manager, Quality (links to VS-31), Accredited Lab (links to W3680), Import Coordinator, Vendor, DC
fields.Volume: Per regulated shipment / per product re-test

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-dispatch of "dispatch samples to the DTI-accredited laboratory and manage the test program" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "Product Compliance Manager/Lab track testing to completion" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-581 (ensure controlled execution — Import ICC/SOC Clearance, Testing Lab & Sticker Management (PA-117.2).)
- operational: lab planning (W3680); operational: clear acceptance criteria and re-test protocol
Pain Points / Risks: - **Testing-delay risk**: Accredited-lab lead-times exceed 2 weeks, triggering demurrage (links to W249); mitigated by lab planning (W3680)
- **Borderline-result risk**: Results near the limit create re-test decisions; mitigated by clear acceptance criteria and re-test protocol
System Touchpoints: - Quality/lab (links to VS-31/W625); technical file (links to W3668); ICC application (links to W3673); lab relationship (links to W3680); sample-failure (links to W3679)

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager/Quality dispatch samples to the DTI-accredited laboratory and manage the test program: confirm the applicable PNS test methods (e.g., tensile/yield for steel, compressive strength for cement, electrical safety for wires/breakers), the sample integrity, and the test scope

Product Compliance Manager/Lab track testing to completion (5–10 days typical), manage re-test where a result is borderline/inconclusive, and capture the test report into the technical file (links to W3668) and ICC application (links to W3673)

Product Compliance Manager/Quality evaluate results against the PNS acceptance criteria, determine pass/fail, and on fail trigger sample-failure disposition (links to W3679) and vendor recovery (links to W3686); on pass, proceed to certificate issuance (links to W3677)

fields.Participants: Import Coordinator, Customs Broker (links to VS-87), Product Compliance Manager, DC (links to VS-04), Finance (links to VS-17/W144), Records (links to VS-88)

workflows.name: ICC/SOC Certificate Issuance & Customs Release Coordination

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "verify the certificate scope/quantity/validity, and coordinate ICC sticker…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-import of "Import Coordinator use the ICC/SOC certificate to finalize customs clearance" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-file of "Import Coordinator/Finance capture the certification cost" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-581 (ensure controlled execution — Import ICC/SOC Clearance, Testing Lab & Sticker Management (PA-117.2).)
- operational: expediting the test/issuance chain; operational: verification
Pain Points / Risks: - **Release-delay risk**: Customs cannot release without the BPS certificate, extending dwell; mitigated by expediting the test/issuance chain
- **Certificate-scope risk**: Certificate quantity/scope mismatch with received goods; mitigated by verification
System Touchpoints: - Customs clearance (links to VS-87); DC receiving (links to VS-04); landed cost (links to W144/VS-02.2); sticker management (links to W3678); ICC register (links to W3672); records (links to VS-88)

steps.activity: Import Coordinator/Product Compliance Manager obtain the ICC/SOC certificate from BPS upon successful test, verify the certificate scope/quantity/validity, and coordinate ICC sticker issuance (links to W3678) for the certified units

Customs Broker/Import Coordinator use the ICC/SOC certificate to finalize customs clearance (links to VS-87) — the BPS certificate is a prerequisite to BOC release of regulated goods — and coordinate delivery to DC (links to VS-04/VS-02.2) and putaway (links to W3678 sticker application)

Import Coordinator/Finance capture the certification cost (BPS fees, testing, stickers) into landed cost (links to W144/VS-02.2) and archive the certificate to the ICC register (links to W3672) and technical file (links to W3668) per retention (links to VS-88)

fields.Participants: Product Compliance Manager, DC Team (links to VS-04), Import Coordinator, Quality (links to VS-31), Audit (links to VS-21), Records (links to VS-88)
fields.Volume: Stickers per certified unit/package across regulated imports

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-reconcile of "reconcile sticker stock to certificates" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "DC Team/Product Compliance Manager apply ICC stickers to individual" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "Product Compliance Manager/Audit manage sticker integrity" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-581 (ensure controlled execution — Import ICC/SOC Clearance, Testing Lab & Sticker Management (PA-117.2).)
- operational: procurement planning and stock control; operational: controlled-stock discipline and reconciliation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Sticker-shortage risk**: Insufficient stickers blocks putaway/dispatch; mitigated by procurement planning and stock control
- **Sticker-fraud risk**: ICC stickers stolen/diverted and applied to uncertified goods; mitigated by controlled-stock discipline and reconciliation
System Touchpoints: - DC operations (links to VS-04); quality (links to VS-31); inventory/sticker stock (links to VS-05); audit (links to VS-21); records (links to VS-88); ICC register (links to W3672)

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager/Import Coordinator procure ICC stickers from BPS in the quantities authorized by the certificate, manage the sticker as a controlled/serialized consumable (receipt, secure storage, issuance), and reconcile sticker stock to certificates
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Import Coordinator / DC

steps.activity: DC Team/Product Compliance Manager apply ICC stickers to individual units/packages before putaway or dispatch to stores (links to VS-04), per BPS marking rules and certificate scope; verify application completeness and capture the sticker-application record
steps.r: DC Team / Product Compliance Manager / Quality

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager/Audit manage sticker integrity: periodic sticker-vs-certificate reconciliation, investigation of sticker shortage/discrepancy, control against theft/misuse, and audit reporting (links to W3672/VS-21); manage expired/obsolete sticker destruction

fields.Participants: Product Compliance Manager, Import Coordinator, Customs Broker (links to VS-87), Vendor Mgmt (links to VS-03), Finance (links to VS-17), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Quality (links to VS-31), DC (links to VS-04)
fields.Volume: Low frequency; high cost per event

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-notify of "notify BPS, and prevent release to customs/DC pending disposition" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-import of "Import execute the BPS-directed disposition" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-capture of "capture the failure cost" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-581 (ensure controlled execution — Import ICC/SOC Clearance, Testing Lab & Sticker Management (PA-117.2).)
- operational: lot segregation and BPS-directed disposition; operational: contract terms and documented root cause
Pain Points / Risks: - **Lot-contamination risk**: A failed sample may invalidate the whole shipment; mitigated by lot segregation and BPS-directed disposition
- **Cost-recovery risk**: Vendor disputes recovery for a BPS-directed re-export/destruction; mitigated by contract terms and documented root cause
System Touchpoints: - Stop-sell/hold (links to W3684); customs/drawback (links to VS-87.2); vendor recovery (links to W3686); quality/CAPA (links to VS-31); finance (links to VS-17); legal (links to VS-100.3)

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager manage the failed-sample event: confirm the failure against the PNS criterion, place the affected lot on hold/stop-sell (links to W3684), notify BPS, and prevent release to customs/DC pending disposition

Product Compliance Manager/Import execute the BPS-directed disposition: re-export or destruction under DTI supervision (the entire shipment may be affected), manage customs/drawback implications (links to VS-87.2), and coordinate with the vendor on root cause and recovery (links to W3686)
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Import / Customs Broker / Vendor

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager/Vendor Mgmt drive corrective action (vendor process fix, re-test, re-shipment), capture the failure cost (product loss, freight, demurrage, destruction, re-procurement) for vendor recovery (links to W3686), and feed root cause to quality (links to VS-31) and assortment decisions (links to VS-01)
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Vendor Mgmt / Finance

fields.Participants: Product Compliance Manager, Quality (links to VS-31), Procurement (links to VS-34), Import Coordinator, Vendor Mgmt (links to VS-03), Vendor Scorecard (links to VS-67), Finance (links to VS-17.4)
fields.Volume: DTI-accredited labs used for regulated-product testing

workflows.name: Testing Laboratory Relationship, Accreditation & Cost Management

Automation Opportunity: - System rule-based auto-approval of "approved-lab list and diversify to avoid bottleneck" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-route of "route tests to optimize cycle-time and cost" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-count of "discount, allocate testing cost to landed cost" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-581 (ensure controlled execution — Import ICC/SOC Clearance, Testing Lab & Sticker Management (PA-117.2).)
- operational: diversification and capacity planning; operational: accreditation monitoring and backup labs
Pain Points / Risks: - **Lab-bottleneck risk**: Single lab with long lead-time constrains clearance; mitigated by diversification and capacity planning
- **Accreditation-lapse risk**: Lab loses BPS accreditation mid-engagement; mitigated by accreditation monitoring and backup labs
System Touchpoints: - Quality/lab (links to VS-31); procurement (links to VS-34); landed cost (links to W144); ICC pipeline (links to W3673); program analytics (links to W3685); vendor scorecard (links to VS-67)

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager/Quality/Procurement qualify and select DTI-accredited testing laboratories: confirm BPS accreditation scope (the PNS test methods covered), capacity, turnaround, cost, and location; maintain the approved-lab list and diversify to avoid bottleneck

Product Compliance Manager/Quality manage the lab relationship and performance: turnaround SLA, test-quality, pricing, and capacity planning against the regulated-import pipeline (links to W3673); route tests to optimize cycle-time and cost

Product Compliance Manager/Finance manage testing cost: benchmark per-test cost across labs, consolidate volume for discount, allocate testing cost to landed cost (links to W144), and publish testing cost/cycle-time analytics to program reporting (links to W3685) and merchandising (links to VS-01)
